No LLMs were used as judges in this paper. The paper uses traditional automatic metrics and human evaluation.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on machine translation evaluation with specific emphasis on gender bias mitigation. Key contributions include systematic testing of intrinsic debiasing methods (Hard-Debiasing, INLP, LEACE) on neural machine translation models across different languages and design choices. Human evaluation was limited to a subset of translations to validate automatic gender prediction metrics.
